title: [ENISA] CVE-2026-58115 - Withdrawn
summary: CVE-2026-58115 Catalog: ENISA Status: Withdrawn Exploited: No Status Updated: 2026-11-10 08:00 UTC Evidence Sources: 1 First Seen: 2026-11-03 Asserted: 2026-11-03 Scope Notes: Affected: Siemens / SIMATIC IoT2050 | Description: A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (6ES7647-0BA00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 Basic (6ES7647-0BA00-0YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 M.2 (6ES7647-0BB00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 SM (6ES7647-0CA00-1AA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed). Affected devices do not enforce authentication on the Node-RED HTTP interface, allowing unauthenticated access to programming nodes that are capable of executing system commands on the server. This could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create malicious flows through the HTTP interface in order to execute arbitrary code on the underlying server with maximum privileges. | Patched since: 2026/08/11 | Exploitation type: unknown | CWEs: CWE-306 | Origin source: CNW | Notes: https://cert-portal.siemens.com/productcert/html/ssa-834709.html | Withdrawn: no longer listed in the ENISA CNW EU KEV catalog as of 2026-11-10.
